item.title: 【Cinema Center】MOVIE - [PACK] Ultimate Disney Descendants Media Collection
item.description:
In-Universe Materials (Movies/TV Minis/Books/Comics/Etc)​

Listed below is every single piece of existing media in the Descendants canon in the order it should be read/watched in should you want to ingest the story chronologically. Most of the hardcover books were scanned by me. The ones that were not will be marked as such, and will be replaced with my own scans soon, as most scans online exist in pretty shitty compressed quality. The graphic novels were obtained by me.

I can reupload anything on this page easily. Just ask.​
